notes: Latest published GitHub Release verified on 2026-10-26; this is a prerelease, not a stable release.
The release tag resolves to the immutable source commit above. Builds must check out this exact commit, never a floating branch.
Electron is pinned to 44.7.0 by the release's pnpm-workspace.yaml fingerprint and pnpm lockfile. Inspect the packaged binary to record its embedded Node.js version.
The standalone primary runtime Node.js is 24.21.0 and Python is 3.12.14; both are pinned upstream runtimes and are distinct from the Windows build host's installed Python.
The Windows build host is separately pinned in buildHostToolchain. Python 3.12.10 is used on the host because actions/python-versions publishes a Windows x64 build for 3.12.10 but not 3.12.14.
